english.note: Use 提供 as the all-purpose choice for making something available, especially money, information, or a service.
Use this as the all-purpose choice for supplying something, especially information, evidence, services, or resources.
Use 提供 for explicitly supplying a resource, service, or option in a neutral context.
Use this when making a thing, service, resource, or facility available for someone to use or consider.
Use this when making a person, witness, document, or other item available to someone.
Use this when “lend” means to furnish or make assistance, resources, or facilities available.
Use this when bring means to supply or contribute something such as information, help, or a viewpoint.
